falseSynonyms.zh: 事實不等於 concept fact 是可被視為真實／已確立的資訊；concept 是用來理解或組織思想的概念。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A fact is a piece of information; a concept is an idea or mental category.

falseSynonyms.zh: 例子不等於 concept example 是用來說明概念的具體實例；不是概念本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An example illustrates a concept; it is not the concept itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 主題不等於 concept topic 是討論內容的題目；concept 是對該主題中的某種想法或原理。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A topic is what you discuss; a concept is an idea within or about it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞語不等於 concept 一個詞可以代表概念，但字詞本身和概念不是同一層次。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A word labels a concept; the label and the concept are not identical.

falseSynonyms.zh: 計劃不等於所有 concept plan 是具體行動安排；concept 可以只是早期想法或理論觀念。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A plan specifies action; a concept may remain abstract.

falseSynonyms.zh: 意見不等於 concept opinion 是個人判斷或看法；concept 可以是客觀分析中的術語或抽象類別。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An opinion is a personal judgement; a concept need not be personal.

falseSynonyms.zh: 定義不等於 concept definition 解釋一個詞／概念的意思；不是概念本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A definition explains a concept; it does not replace it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 提案只在特定 sense 接近 concept proposal 是供考慮的具體方案；concept 若只是抽象想法，不能直接改成 proposal。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A proposal is an actionable suggestion; a concept may be only an idea.
